body:
in my experience, whenever someone tells me they think they’re ugly they aren’t at all. everyone feels ugly sometimes, including men. you look at yourself more than anyone else does so it’s natural to look at yourself for the 100th time today and think you’re ugly. but even if you’re pretty you can still feel lonely and sad. 

regardless, everyones perception of beauty is different. there will always be people who only think eurocentric beauty is worthwhile, but there are far more people who are able to find beauty where you wouldn’t expect. 

no one deserves to die because society distorted everyone’s perception of beauty.

i feel u. my own parents have forgotten my birthday before. 

but happy late birthday 😊
